column2: Lightning doesn't hesitate. Once you decide, strike to the end.
They say if you go from the Storm Plateau to the east cliff, an old man sits atop an iron-pillar peak where lightning never stops
Whale-bone rock on the west sea shore
Even if you've seen the end of the sea, you don't yet know its depth.
They say if you go from the Azure Sea Pavilion to the north shore, an old man sits on a giant whale bone half-buried in sand, listening to the waves
...They say someone stands beside a big rock at the southeast end of the world, but no one has ever heard them speak
Lotus Pavilion on the southwest pond
Even in a dream, your feet must stand on the ground.
They say an old man dozes even after sunrise in a pavilion in the middle of a far southwest pond. He only listens to the dreams of those born twice
Observatory at the south end of the Nebula Garden (Heavenly Realm)
Stars travel the same path every day. No martial art beats consistency.
They say at the south end of the Nebula Garden, an old man counts stars with a staff atop a round observatory where copper rings turn on their own
Deep forest of the southwest fields (Myriad Tree Grove)
A tree doesn't hurry. Yet it always wins.
They say an old man sits on a mossy stone in the middle of a ring of twisted old trees in the southwest fields
